New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 
S.O. 4209(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH543 in the 
stretch of land from Km. il.2 to Km. 6.3 (Competent Authority (Land Acquisition) & Sub Divisional Officer 


(Revenue), Balaghat,Tehsil - Balaghat, District- Balaghat) in the district of BALAGHAT in the state of MADHYA 
PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Competent Authority (Land 
Acquisition) & Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue), Balaghat in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

को "मातृभूमि" और "हिन्दू" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3डी की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3डी 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


S.O. 4206(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S 0. 117(E) Dated:09/01/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH66 in the stretch of land from Km. 379.1 to Km. 460.7 in the district of ALAPPUZHA in the state of 
KERALA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Mathrubhumi” and “ The Hindu” 
both dated 05.02.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

samyukta Karnataka” and “Deccan Hearald” both dated 07-l0-2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the 
said Act;

competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (.) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section () of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said

उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 08.12.2022 को “ द टाईम्स ऑफ इंडिया” और “ गुजरात समाचार ” दोनों में प्रकाशित 
किया गया था; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


S.O. 4202(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highway, S.O. 4978(E) dated 20.10.2022 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening /four-laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH-56 on the stretch of land from Km 95+550 to Km 132+250 in (Prant Officer, Bodeli) in the District of 
Chhotaudepur in the State of GUJARAT. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification S.0.4978 (E) dated 20.10.2022 has been published in “The 
Times of India" and "Gujarat Samachar” both dated 08.12.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said 
Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 


declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


S.O. 4200(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, number S.O. 4828 (E), dated the 07 October 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 1956 
(48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building of National Highway No. 319-A (Two Lane 
/Four Lane with Paved shoulder, etc), maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 319 A 
(Mohania-Ramgarh-Chausa-Buxar) in the stretch of land from Km. 30+660 to km 65+821 in the District of Buxar in 
the state of Bihar; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in Dainik Jagaran and Prabhat 
Khabar dated the 10 November 2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के बालाघाट जिले में NH543 के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी.5.9 (तहसील - लालवर्रा ,

ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा |

प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों 
की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश 
द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा AT अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा |

New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


S.O. 4207(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH543 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 5.9 (Tehsil - Lalwarra, District- Balaghat) in the district of BALAGHAT in the 
state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Competent Authority (Land 
Acquisition) & Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue), Waraseoni in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner,

का.आ. 4203(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 956 (7956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (() के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या २०६५ दिनांक: ३ मई २०२३ का.आ., जो भारत के UII, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के मांड्या जिले में NH275 के 
कि.मी. 99.500 से कि.मी.223.860 (मैसूर-मडिकेरी खंड ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ा करने / चार लेन का 
बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "२६.०५.२०२३ " 
को थे "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" और "विजयवाणी" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 
और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया है ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3डी की उपधारा (4) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3डी 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3डी की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


9.0. 4203(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S O NO 2065 Dated: 3rd May 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part वी, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH275 in the stretch of land from Km. 99.500 to Km. 223.860 (Mysuru- Madikeri Section) in the district 
of MANDYA in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “THE TIMES OF INDIA” and 
“VIJAYAVANI” both dated 26.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
